{{Quote|One of the Hidden Chain strike teams was sent to take captives from Hutta. They must not have been too careful around the Hutts. They've run into trouble with a local crime lord, and they're stranded there.|[[Sa'har Kateen]]|<ref name="Defiance" />}}
During the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian Civil War]] between [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] and the [[Hidden Chain]] splinter faction, Hidden Chain forces '''raided''' the [[Minboosa District]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in order to capture hostages. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] raiders came into conflict with the [[Refinery Security Force]]s serving [[Vobbara Yusinduu]] when the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] ordered a lockdown that prevented the raiders leaving. They were eventually defeated by [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and [[Sa'har Kateen]].<ref name="Mire" />
